style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Magnolia Christmas Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: Add a touch of festive luxury to your home with this stunning 58cm magnolia wreath. Rich in colour and beautifully detailed, it combines classic Christmas tones with elegant design to create a truly eye-catching seasonal piece. Featuring large, lifelike magnolia blooms, this wreath is thoughtfully arranged with complementary foliage and textured accents to create depth and visual interest. The blend of warm metallics and traditional hues brings a sophisticated twist to festive decorating, making it perfect for both classic and contemporary interiors. At 58cm in diameter, it makes a striking statement on front doors, above mantelpieces, or as a centrepiece within your home. Crafted from high-quality artificial materials, it offers lasting beauty, allowing you to enjoy its charm year after year. Perfect for welcoming guests with seasonal style, this magnolia wreath adds warmth, elegance and a hint of festive glamour to any space. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Wreath Width: W58cm. Wipe clean with a soft cloth.
